metas.name: Forrest Gump
metas.description: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Ulidavaru Kandanthe
metas.description: A journalist sets out to uncover the truth behind an incident, through the perspectives of different people, unraveling how they and their lives are intertwined with it.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: Lucia
metas.description: A man suffering from insomnia is tricked into buying a drug, Lucia, that makes his desires come true in his dreams, blurring the line between fantasy and reality.

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: Shahid
metas.description: The account of Human Rights lawyer Shahid Azmi, an ordinary citizen with an extraordinary commitment to justice.

metas.name: Deewana
metas.description: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: Jigarthanda
metas.description: An aspiring director targets a ruthless gangster because he wants to make a violent gangster film. His discreet attempts to research the gangster fail miserably. Finally when he gets caught snooping, things hit the fan.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: With Spider-Man's identity now revealed, Peter asks Doctor Strange for help. When a spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds start to appear.

metas.name: Section 375
metas.description: A celebrated Bollywood director Rohan Khurana stands accused by a female member of his crew, Anjali Dangle of having raped her at his residence.

metas.name: Barfi!
metas.description: Three young people learn that love can neither be defined nor contained by society's definition of normal and abnormal.

metas.name: Padosan
metas.description: A simple man from a village falls in love with his new neighbor. He enlists the help of his musical-theater friends to woo the lovely girl-next-door away from her music teacher.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: Baron "Bear" Bailey breaks a novelty charm to force his co-worker Nikki Freeman to love him, but the supernatural compulsion warps her mind into violent obsession, trapping him in a nightmare he cannot wish away.

metas.name: Pizza
metas.description: A pizza delivery boy lands in a mysterious circumstance and it works a dramatic change in his life.

metas.name: Vettaiyaadu Vilaiyaadu
metas.description: A Police Officer investigates a series of brutal rapes and murders, with the culprits seeming to cover more than one country.

metas.name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
metas.description: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, discovers Christmas Town, but his attempts to bring Christmas to his home causes confusion.

metas.name: Court - State Vs. A Nobody
metas.description: A passionate defense attorney fights against prejudice and corruption in the justice system while representing a teenage client wrongly presumed guilty of a serious crime.

metas.name: Njan Prakashan
metas.description: Pining for a lavish life abroad, a lazy but lovable guy-next-door crafts a scam to avoid a career in nursing and find a wealthy spouse to secure a visa.

metas.name: Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!
metas.description: Lovinder Singh, a thief now in custody and facing trial, reflects on his life of crime while the press reflect on how he managed to get away with so much before being arrested.

metas.name: Baazigar
metas.description: A young man with a vendetta against a business tycoon seduces the man's younger daughter, but she begins to suspect her new lover's connection with her elder sister and his ulterior motive.

metas.name: Pyaar Ka Punchnama
metas.description: Nishant starts dating Charu while his roommates Rajat and Vikrant already have girlfriends in Neha and Rhea respectively. Trouble starts when the guys feel that their girlfriends are dominating them.

metas.name: The Whale
metas.description: A reclusive, morbidly obese English teacher attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter.

metas.name: Ayan
metas.description: A young man's smuggling lifestyle takes a serious turn, when a fierce rival tries to eliminate him from the business.

metas.name: Writer
metas.description: A writer at a police station gets trapped in an illegal custody case involving an innocent PHD student. With his guilt and regret looming large, can he save the young man?

metas.name: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the 74th Hunger Games sparks a rebellion in the Districts of Panem.

metas.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
metas.description: Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in rea...

metas.name: The Judge
metas.description: Big-city lawyer Hank Palmer returns to his childhood home where his father, the town's judge, is suspected of murder. Hank sets out to discover the truth; along the way he reconnects with his estranged family.

metas.name: Photographer
metas.description: Photographer follows Veera, a troubled and obsessive photographer determined to prove his worth in a world that has long dismissed him. Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.

metas.name: The Ballad of Wallis Island
metas.description: An eccentric lottery winner who lives alone on a remote island tries to make his fantasies come true by getting his favorite musicians to perform at his home.

metas.name: Michael
metas.description: The early life of musician Michael Jackson, from the discovery of his talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to the artist whose creative ambition fueled a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

metas.name: Sardar
metas.description: A spy, who is estranged from his family due to a mission, suddenly meets his police officer son.

metas.name: Scream
metas.description: In the small town of Woodsboro, California, a masked killer known as Ghostface begins murdering high school students, and a group of friends must use their knowledge of horror movies to unmask the killer.

metas.name: Me Before You
metas.description: A girl in a small town forms an unlikely bond with a recently-paralyzed man she's taking care of.

metas.name: Vendhu Thanindhathu Kaadu
metas.description: Muthu, a low caste youngster, goes to the streets of Mumbai for a living. His quest takes him to a series of unexpected events, where he gets involved in the underground activities of Mumbai's Tamil gangsters. Will he get to the top?

metas.name: The Equalizer
metas.description: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters.

metas.name: Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: Attarintiki Daredi
metas.description: The scion of a powerful family is tasked with retrieving an estranged family member.

metas.name: Dumb and Dumber
metas.description: After a woman leaves a briefcase at the airport terminal, a dumb limo driver and his dumber friend set out on a hilarious cross-country road trip to Aspen to return it.

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: Bhakshak
metas.description: Revolves around the journey of an unwavering woman's quest to seek justice and her perseverance in getting a heinous crime to light.

metas.name: Julayi
metas.description: After helping the police foil a violent heist, a sharp minded young man must evade the criminal mastermind whose plans he has thwarted.

metas.name: Mom
metas.description: After her daughter is sexually assaulted at a party, a furious mother sets out to destroy the lives of the four perpetrators who walked away free.

metas.name: Jogi
metas.description: Amid tension in 1980s India, three friends of different faiths unite in a noble yet dangerous effort to save hundreds in their town.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: At an archaeological dig in the ancient city of Hamunaptra, an American serving in the French Foreign Legion accidentally awakens a mummy who begins to wreak havoc as he searches for the reincarnation of his long-lost love.

metas.name: Dressed to Kill
metas.description: A mysterious blonde woman kills one of the patients of a psychiatrist and then goes after the high-class hooker who witnessed the murder.
